abstract:
Small clinical cohorts are a reality in translational oncology, making reliable model validation essential. Our ESMO AI 2026 poster examines how cross-validation design affects reported biomarker performance and what this means for evaluating predictions when clinical data are limited. Presented at ESMO AI 2026. The poster will be available to download after November 17, [...]
